newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread says current performance in-line.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread says current performance in-line.

text.p: Brewer to leisure group Whitbread Plc said on Tuesday the group had made a good start to the new financial year and "performance was in-line with expectations."

"(Chief executive) David Thomas and his team are focused on their key tasks which are to continue the growth in sales and to improve the return on capital employed," chairman Sir Michael Angus told the annual meeting.
"Their prospects of achieving both are good," he added.
The chairman also said that Peter Jarvis was stepping down as a director as from today.
